title: MAI-T1D Synthetic Data Generation Framework
summary: A modular, phase-gated pipeline that generates privacy-preserving synthetic genomic (PLINK/VCF) and clinical/tabular datasets for the NIH-funded Multimodal AI for Type 1 Diabetes consortium. Genotype matrices are synthesized using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as the stable default, with CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer also called for tabular/clinical data synthesis.
needs: Confirm whether CTGANSynthesizer/CopulaGANSynthesizer paths are actually exercised in production runs or only offered as options in csv_utils.py/make_schema_yaml.py.
